prompt: Give me five funny notes to tell my long time wife I love her very much
response:
1. "Dear, you're the best thing that ever happened to me, even if you do hog the blankets at night."
2. "I love you more than all the tacos in Mexico combined."
3. "You're so beautiful, even your parking tickets are charming."
4. "I love you as much as I love my pillow - which is to say, a whole lot!"
5. "Without you, my life would be like a sandwich without mayo - still good, but something's missing."
